nodes.description: address public owner; set to msg.sender in Owned constructor and used by onlyOwner gate
address public newOwner; pending owner used by two-step ownership transfer
string public symbol initialized to TEXASINU
string public name initialized to Texas Inu
uint8 public decimals set to 9 in constructor
uint256 _totalSupply; total minted supply allocated to owner
address public newun; address blocked as transfer recipient but silently rewritten in transferFrom
mapping(address=>uint256) balances; token balance ledger
mapping(address=>mapping(address=>uint256)) allowed; allowance ledger
constructor() public { owner = msg.sender; }
function transferOwnership(address) public onlyOwner sets newOwner
function acceptOwnership() public requires msg.sender == newOwner and moves ownership
constructor() public mints _totalSupply to owner and sets token metadata
function transfernewun(address) public onlyOwner assigns newun
function totalSupply() public view returns _totalSupply.sub(balances[address(0)])
function balanceOf(address) public view returns balances[tokenOwner]
function transfer(address,uint256) public requires to != newun and moves balances with SafeMath
function approve(address,uint256) public writes allowed[msg.sender][spender]
function transferFrom(address,address,uint256) public; mutates newun and spends allowance
function allowance(address,address) public view returns allowed[tokenOwner][spender]
function approveAndCall(address,uint256,bytes) public performs external receiveApproval call
function() external payable { revert(); } rejects ether on the token
function clearCNDAO() public onlyOwner transfers whole contract balance to msg.sender
function() external payable {} accepts ether on GokuToken
library SafeMath add with overflow require
library SafeMath sub with underflow require
library SafeMath mul with overflow require
library SafeMath div with zero-division require
msg.sender used as initial owner in Owned constructor
msg.sender compared to owner in onlyOwner modifier
msg.sender compared to newOwner in acceptOwnership
msg.sender used as balance/allowance key in transfer, approve, transferFrom and approveAndCall
msg.sender cast to payable and used as ether recipient in clearCNDAO
_owner.transfer(address(this).balance) external value transfer executed before no further state changes
ApproveAndCallFallBack(spender).receiveApproval(...) calls arbitrary caller-supplied contract
unconditional newun = to assignment inside transferFrom bypasses the onlyOwner transfernewun setter
SafeMath subtraction of allowance/balance in transferFrom reverts on insufficient funds (DoS path)
_newOwner parameter of transferOwnership
_newun parameter of transfernewun
tokenOwner parameter of balanceOf
to parameter of transfer
tokens parameter of transfer
spender parameter of approve
tokens parameter of approve
from parameter of transferFrom
to parameter of transferFrom
tokens parameter of transferFrom
spender parameter of approveAndCall, also the external callee
tokens parameter of approveAndCall
data parameter forwarded to the external receiveApproval call
address payable _owner local variable holding msg.sender in clearCNDAO

edges.reason: Owned constructor assigns owner = msg.sender, making the deployer the privileged owner
onlyOwner modifier requires msg.sender == owner before transferOwnership executes
acceptOwnership requires msg.sender == newOwner before ownership is transferred
transfer debits balances[msg.sender] using caller-controlled accounting identity
approve writes allowed[msg.sender][spender] keyed by caller address
transferFrom decrements allowed[from][msg.sender] using caller as spender
approveAndCall writes allowed[msg.sender][spender] and forwards msg.sender to the external callee
clearCNDAO derives the ether recipient from msg.sender under the onlyOwner gate
onlyOwner compares msg.sender against the owner state variable
transferOwnership stores _newOwner into the newOwner state variable
acceptOwnership reads owner for the OwnershipTransferred event and then reassigns it
acceptOwnership validates and consumes newOwner, then clears it to address(0)
clearCNDAO is protected by onlyOwner which reads the owner state variable
constructor sets _totalSupply to 1000000000000000000000000
constructor initializes the symbol metadata
constructor initializes the name metadata
constructor initializes decimals
constructor credits balances[owner] with the entire supply
constructor uses owner as the recipient of the initial mint and of the Transfer event
totalSupply derives from _totalSupply minus the zero-address balance
totalSupply subtracts balances[address(0)] from _totalSupply and can revert if that balance exceeds supply
balanceOf returns the balances mapping entry for tokenOwner
transfernewun writes the privileged newun state variable
transfer requires to != newun, blocking transfers to the restricted address
transferFrom silently assigns newun = to when newun == address(0), bypassing the owner-only setter
transfer subtracts from and adds to balances via SafeMath
transferFrom subtracts from balances[from] and adds to balances[to] via SafeMath
approve stores the allowance into the allowed mapping
transferFrom decrements allowed[from][msg.sender] and reverts on underflow
allowance returns allowed[tokenOwner][spender]
approveAndCall writes the allowance before the external call
clearCNDAO performs an external value transfer of the entire contract balance
the ether transfer recipient is derived from the caller-controlled msg.sender
approveAndCall invokes receiveApproval on an attacker-supplied spender contract
the callee re-enters the token contract while approveAndCall has not yet returned
transferFrom unconditionally rewrites the privileged newun variable from the to parameter
SafeMath subtractions on balance and allowance revert when the caller lacks funds or approval
transfer delegates subtraction to SafeMath.sub
transfer delegates addition to SafeMath.add
transferFrom delegates subtraction to SafeMath.sub
_newOwner parameter is stored into the newOwner state variable
_newun parameter is stored into the privileged newun state variable
tokenOwner parameter selects the balances entry returned by balanceOf
to parameter receives the credited balance in transfer
tokens parameter is the debited/credited amount in transfer
spender parameter keys the allowance written by approve
tokens parameter is the allowance value stored by approve
from parameter is debited in transferFrom
to parameter is credited and checked against newun in transferFrom
tokens parameter is the amount moved in transferFrom
spender parameter becomes the callee of the external receiveApproval call
tokens parameter is written as allowance and forwarded to the callee
arbitrary data parameter is forwarded to the untrusted external call
_owner local receives msg.sender and becomes the recipient of the contract balance

normalization_plan.reason: _newOwner only exists as the input that is assigned to newOwner inside transferOwnership
_newun only exists as the input that is assigned to newun inside transfernewun
tokenOwner is only used to index the balances mapping read by balanceOf
to is only used as the credit target inside transfer
tokens is only used as the moved amount inside transfer
spender is only used to key the allowance written by approve
tokens is only used as the allowance value stored by approve
from is only used to select the debited balance and allowance inside transferFrom
to is only used as the credit target and newun candidate inside transferFrom
tokens is only used as the moved amount inside transferFrom
spender is only used as the allowance key and the external callee inside approveAndCall
tokens is only used as the allowance value and forwarded argument inside approveAndCall
data is only forwarded into the external receiveApproval call made by approveAndCall
the _owner local only exists to receive msg.sender and become the recipient of the unchecked balance transfer executed in clearCNDAO
